text:
zoe: Heads-up: Vendor QC flagged a batch of RTX-F series units for particulate contamination during pre-shipment inspection. Affected manifest covers two marketplace SKUs (MKP-PLAT, MKP-EDGE) and one SI partner reserved pool (SI-LUMEN). Need allocation decision ASAP.

logistics-bot: QC_ALERT: Batch QX-992 flagged 2025-02-14T09:12Z. Status: Hold. Origin: Vendor WestFab. Action: vendor to issue remediation plan or recall.

omar_supply: quick numbers: total batch = RTX-F x200. Allocations: SI-LUMEN = 80 (reserved for SI partner), MKP-PLAT = 70, MKP-EDGE = 50. Local buffers: US-central RTX-F x12, EU-south RTX-F x10.

tess_market: marketplace side: MKP-PLAT has 30 active paid trials in the pipeline with an expected roll-start next week. MKP-EDGE is mostly flexible. We should keep trials alive if possible.

ryan_sales: SI partner Lumen needs full 80 to meet integration timeline for their managed service launch on Feb 24. We said availability would be guaranteed. If we miss, they push the announcement.

marta_ops: product/infrastructure note: if hardware is delayed, we can soft-mock capacity for trials with limited throughput using our cloud-backed fallbacks, but that costs money and might not satisfy SI load tests.

zoe: options on the table:
1) Hold all units until vendor resolves (risk: missed commitments)
2) Reallocate buffers and stagger deliveries (risk: partial breaches)
3) Offer marketplace trials via soft-mock + credits while prioritizing SI pool
4) Pull from alternate vendor stockpile (higher unit cost + lead time)

omar_supply: vendor offered two remedies: onsite cleaning + certification (+72h) or rework + new packing (+120h). Alternate vendor quote: RTX-F x90 available, ship +5 days, +22% cost.

tess_market: marketplace proposal: move MKP-PLAT 30 paid trials to a "virtualized trial" flow using GPU cloud fallback (we have partnership credits) and automatically issue 20% usage credit. That preserves UX while we resolve hardware.

ryan_sales: for SI-LUMEN: they will accept a staged delivery: first 40 units by Feb 20, rest by Feb 28, if we provide signed mitigation and test run data. Can we guarantee first 40?

omar_supply: current buffers only cover 22 units. We could tap alternate vendor for 20 units to hit 42 for the first tranche (cost + expedited freight). That would leave marketplace short.
marta_ops: alternative is to run Lumen's integration tests on a mix of on-prem hardware + cloud mock; SI may accept if we provide end-to-end telemetry that matches expected throughput. This reduces immediate hardware needs but requires Ops time.

zoe: decision draft: prioritize SI-LUMEN tranche (protect the partnership announcement), use alternate vendor to top up first 42 units, move MKP-PLAT trials to virtualized flow with 20% credits, hold MKP-EDGE until QC cleared. Will require finance approval for extra cost.

omar_supply: action items:
- request PO to alternate vendor for RTX-F x20 expedited (owner: omar_supply)
- instruct vendor WestFab to start cleaning protocol and send certification (owner: zoe)
- tess_market -> move 30 trials to virtual flow and prepare customer comms template (owner: tess_market)
- marta_ops -> prepare test telemetry package for SI to reduce risk (owner: marta_ops)
- finance -> approve expedited spend (owner: finance-team)

ryan_sales: pinging Lumen with staged-delivery plan and telemetry offer. Will confirm acceptance by EOD.

tess_market: drafted comms to trial customers, including credit offer, will post to #customer-ops for sign-off.

omar_supply: alternate vendor PO submitted at 2025-02-14T10:30Z, expedited freight option selected. Awaiting confirmation.

logistics-bot: Update: WestFab cleaning: vendor responded 2025-02-14T11:00Z, cleaning ETA +72h. Batch status: remediation pending certificate.

marta_ops: starting telemetry packaging now. ETA for delivery to SI: 2025-02-16.

zoe: finance approved temporary spend to secure alternate units if SI confirms staged acceptance.

ryan_sales: Lumen accepts staged delivery with telemetry. They requested a signed mitigation note and commitment to prioritize remaining units.

tess_market: marketplace virtualization live for 30 trials. Support teams alerted. Posting customer comms in 15m.

zoe: timeline: hourly check-ins until remediation certificate arrives or alternate shipment confirms. Keep updates here. Thanks. :raised_hands:

(END)
